# Receiz v116 package artifacts

These immutable package tarballs are built from Receiz release commit
`8a8a828ec90794d3daa3c96ae97077ca2fc10121`. They keep the Wildz v116
integration reproducible while the `116.0.0` packages are not yet available
from the public npm registry.
